label: Fires at D1 after an unrewarded S2 visit, more so after two unrewarded trials.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 0)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -3) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) * ep_dec
explanation: D1-only feature (zero at GO and D2), stronger early in the episode (timing baseline). Beyond timing it is gated by the previous trial having reached S2 without reward (either choice; about +0.13 to +0.15 residual, every other last-trial pattern is slightly negative). Within that gate the magnitude grows with accumulating evidence against S2: the trial before also unrewarded, the trial before also at S2, three unrewarded in a row, and higher observer belief that S1 is good (belief_lo); it is weaker after rare transitions and later in the episode. Some firing also persists one trial later (D1 after an S1 unrewarded trial preceded by an S2 unrewarded one). The free fit (dev 0.45) mostly adds these multi-way interactions on top of the S2-unrewarded gate, which the 3-factor short form cannot express (short dev 0.28). Observed-only; no future variables used.
